title: Audit log created when loyalty points awarded for completed rent with paid status
gherkin:
Feature: Reward and Penalty Audit Logging

Scenario: Loyalty points award triggers audit log entry
  Given a rental transaction with rent status "Completed" and payment status "Paid"
  When loyalty points are assigned to the customer account
  Then an audit log entry shall be created
  And the audit log shall record the loyalty points adjustment event
  And the audit log entry shall be retrievable for traceability
rationale: Verifies that the system creates an audit log whenever loyalty points are awarded, establishing the foundational requirement that reward adjustments are logged. This directly addresses the operative context that loyalty points are awarded only when rent status is Completed and payment status is Paid, and that audit logs must record adjustments with traceability.
